headline: Vendors
lead: Two paths for Lunar New Year Tết 2027 — standard booth registration, and scoped custom-zone RFPs.

meta.description: Join the booth vendor waitlist (Eventeny applications aiming to open October 2026) and open RFPs for Children’s Village, Children’s Theater, and Tween/Teen Maker Spot at Elk Grove Lunar New Year Tết.

booths.title: Booth vendors
booths.body: Food trucks, open cooking, drinks, snacks, craft and merchant booths, and nonprofit info tables will apply through Eventeny when registration opens. Returning 2026 vendors will get an email when the form is live.

waitlist.label: Join the vendor waitlist
waitlist.note: Placement is not guaranteed — this list helps us plan outreach when Eventeny opens.

booths.note: Full booth applications are not open yet. Earliest target: October 2026. Join the waitlist above, watch this page, or wait for our returning-vendor email.

customZones.title: Custom zones
customZones.body: Custom zones are programmed activity footprints on the festival map — not a standard food or craft booth. A preferred producer runs the zone day-of (kids village crafts, children’s stage, tween/teen maker hang) under festival product and placement rules.
customZones.lead: Open solicitations below. Bid one or more lots; awards may split.

lots.title: Children’s Theater Producer
lots.summary: Own a repeatable ~90–120 minute Fairytale Town–style kids stage block (short sets + roam). Ages ~2–8.

lots.title: Children’s Village Vendor
lots.summary: Organize kids activity / craft zones with an adaptable activity menu. Ages ~2–10.

lots.title: Tween / Teen Maker Spot
lots.summary: Maker / challenge / hang activities for ages ~11–17 — not Children’s Village branding.

customZones.note: Questions and proposals go to the contact listed on each RFP.
